card.title: PlayStation 3 Fault Finding Using UART

claims.statement: PS3 syscon stores error logs readable over UART: solder RX, TX and GND (pad locations differ: COK-00X models A–E, SEM-001 model G, DIA-00X H–K, VER-001 L–Q, DYN-001 20xx, and Super Slim) to any USB-TTL adapter, crossing RX/TX.
Use SysconReader with the console plugged in but off; choose Mullion (CXR) or Sherwood (SW) syscon type, AUTH until success, then Get Error Codes; repeated AUTH failures mean wiring problems.
Decode codes with the PS3 Dev Wiki syscon error code list.

procedure: Solder RX/TX/GND for the board revision.
Plug in AC, don't power on.
SysconReader: select port and syscon type, Start, AUTH, Get Error Codes.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
